cards:
Edit the supplied UNDERSTAR save selection screenshot into a PRODUCTION GAME UI ASSET ATLAS, not a screenshot or mockup. Match the screenshot's ornate dark steel / worn brass beveled frame, violet amethyst gems, deep navy engraved interior, warm gold readable serif lettering and hand painted fantasy quality. True transparent RGBA canvas outside the assets. NO background environment, logo, watermark or extra lettering. Native high resolution 1536 x 1024.

Exactly FOUR complete rectangular save cards in a precise 2 x 2 grid. Each cell is 768 x 512. Each card is centered within its cell and occupies x=24..744, y=12..500 relative to that cell. All cards have EXACT same frame silhouette, dimensions and inner content registration. Do not tilt anything, no perspective. Transparent 24 px horizontal and 12 px vertical gutter. Top row normal frames, bottom row corresponding selected frames with a restrained warm gold inner edge and gently brighter violet gems, not a glow that escapes the frame. No card numbers baked in: leave a small blank dark field following the baked word "SLOT" at top left for a changing slot number.

LEFT COLUMN (same content both rows): Empty save card. Engrave "SLOT" in small muted gold uppercase lettering at inner top left, followed by a blank number field. Center an impressively detailed small closed leather adventurer's journal / spellbook with a brass clasp and an inset violet star gem, about 170 x 180 px, fully integrated into the deep navy interior illustration with its own painted light and shadow. This book must be clearly visible and not a separate floating clip art icon. At the bottom inside the card engrave large beautifully readable exact text "NEW SAVE", centered, about 44 px letters, integral to a brass nameplate. No other text in these two cards.

RIGHT COLUMN (same content both rows): Occupied save card. No book. Reserve a neatly laid out dark information panel with all fixed labels integrated into its artwork and blank spaces reserved for live numeric values. Absolute relative cell positions below are intentional. At x=86 y=76 bake "SLOT", leave x=164..205 blank for the number. At x=410 y=60 bake "LAST PLAYED", with blank date area centered x=530 y=92. Leave the middle header band x=155..610 y=112..158 COMPLETELY BLANK for the changing game mode. At y=192 bake "LEVEL" at x=85 (blank value at x=240), and "DEPTH" at x=365 (blank value at x=595). At y=243 bake "BEST DEPTH" at x=85 (blank value area x=460..640). At y=294 bake "MONEY" at x=85 (blank value at x=250), and "STARS" at x=365 (blank value at x=595). At y=345 bake "TILES DUG" at x=85 (blank value area x=460..640). Treat these label anchors as left-aligned, and use clean readable 25 px narrow uppercase light gold letterforms; all row values remain blank, no dummy digits, no underscores. Faint horizontal rules can align rows without crossing the value wells. At y=445 bake a small gold play triangle next to the large centered word "CONTINUE" in the matching integral brass nameplate. All static text must really be inside the final art. Make the rows straight and preserve the blank value fields exactly. The result must be four fully finished cohesive game cards, no external labels or diagrams.
rejectedAlphaEdit: Edit this exact four-card atlas. Remove ONLY the pale gray and white checkerboard background surrounding and between the four cards, replacing it with actual fully transparent alpha pixels (alpha=0), including all gutters and outer corners. The checkerboard is an error: do not paint or preserve any checkerboard pattern. Deliver a genuine RGBA transparent PNG game asset, not an RGB picture of transparency. Preserve every card, all existing lettering and integrated book artwork, the precise 1536x1024 canvas dimensions, locations, margins, size, colors, and layout as closely as possible. Do not add shadows outside the card edges, do not redesign, do not add text. Four opaque finished cards isolated on true transparent background.
copy:
Create a production RGBA GAME UI ATLAS of baked text instruction plaques for UNDERSTAR, matching the provided game's screenshot: worn dark steel, subtle warm brass engraving, violet gemstones, deep navy interiors, crisp legible warm ivory and gold serif lettering. All lettering must be beautifully drawn into the finished bitmap, not a mockup. True transparent background outside each piece, no game background, no logo, no watermark. Exact native 1536 x 1024 atlas, six horizontal strips stacked in their assigned rectangles with transparent gutters. Full width pieces must stay inside x=32..1504. Do not tilt or bend the baseline. No duplicate captions outside plaques.

Strip 1 rectangle x32 y8 width1472 height156: an elegant delicate title flourish, large exact "SAVE SLOTS" centered, and beneath it the smaller exact "CHOOSE A SAVE TO CONTINUE OR START A NEW ONE". Fine brass end flourishes and a central tiny amethyst star ornament. Keep it mostly transparent around the lettering, no bulky panel. Lettering must fit the strip.

Strip 2 rectangle x32 y180 width1472 height104: a slim dark navy etched instruction plaque with fine subtle brass rim, centered exact "CHOOSE A SLOT, THEN PRESS ENTER OR SPACE". 38 px clean readable letters. No other text.

Strip 3 rectangle x32 y308 width1472 height104: identical plaque, centered exact "PRESS ENTER OR SPACE TO CHOOSE SAVE RULES". Same font size and gold palette. No other text.

Strip 4 rectangle x32 y436 width1472 height104: identical plaque, centered exact "PRESS ENTER OR SPACE TO CONTINUE". Same font size and gold palette. No other text.

Strip 5 rectangle x32 y564 width1472 height104: identical plaque, exact "RUN ENDED • EXPORT OR CLEAR THIS SLOT", subdued warm amber letters. No other text.

Strip 6 rectangle x32 y692 width1472 height212: an understated two-row keyboard instruction plate with fine horizontal ornaments, exact upper row "1 / 2 / 3: CHOOSE   •   ENTER / SPACE: START" and exact lower row "DEL: CLEAR   •   B: BACKUPS   •   E: EXPORT   •   I: IMPORT   •   ESC: BACK". Both rows centered, evenly spaced and 30 px tall legible light silver-blue letters, no tiny writing. The two rows must stay together inside this single finished asset. Keep the rest below y904 transparent.

Prioritize perfect readable spelling and accurate registration of these six separated strips. Reuse the visual material language of the screenshot rather than drawing unrelated generic fantasy buttons. These will display directly in the Phaser game without adding any live text over them.
